Let \(f: \RR \to \RR\) be the function defined by
\(f{\left(x \right)} = 4 x - \sin{\left(- x - 8 \right)} - 5\).
Verify that \(f\) is bijective, therefore we have an inverse function \(g = f^{-1}\). Calculate the value of its derivative \(g'(-92)\) at \(-92\).
